headline: DOJ Charges 28 in California Voting Case
standfirst: Plus, court records reveal TikTok ignored internal warnings about child safety.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: The DOJ charged 28 people in California with voting crimes. Separately, TikTok ignored safety warnings.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Court records show TikTok staff flagged child safety risks to executives who failed to act.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Voting integrity is under scrutiny near Election Day. Meanwhile, tech accountability is in focus.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Updates on the California legal proceedings and any further disclosures regarding TikTok policy.

caption:
The Department of Justice is charging 28 people with voting crimes in California as Election Day approaches.

In a separate development, new court records suggest TikTok executives were warned by staff about child safety issues but did not take action. Both stories highlight growing concerns over election security and tech platform responsibility.
